PARAMS = {
    "I1":     (8.0e-6, 4e-6, 10e-6),     # gain-stage current
    "Isf":    (6.5e-6, 3e-6, 8e-6),      # source-follower current (also biases PMOS load)
    "gmid1":  (20.0, 12.0, 24.0),
    "L1":     (0.4, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_sf":(16.0, 10.0, 22.0),
    "Lsf":    (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "gmid_p": (11.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "Lp":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Rf":     (5.0e5, 4.2e5, 7.0e5),
    "Cf":     (1.0e-15, 0.1e-15, 5e-15),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    I1, Isf = p["I1"], p["Isf"]
    # keep within power budget (~5% margin) whatever IREF is
    avail = 47e-6 / VDD * 0.95 - iref
    if avail > 0 and I1 + Isf > avail:
        s = avail / (I1 + Isf); I1 *= s; Isf *= s
    Rf, Cf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"]

    # ---- gain device: vout_dc = vin_dc = Vgs1 ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=1.0)
    vout = m1.vgs
    # ---- source follower (vsb = vout) ----
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=0.35, vsb=vout)
    vamp = vout + msf.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vamp)
    # ---- PMOS diode carrying Isf, mirrored to load (ratio I1/Isf) ----
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Isf, vds=1.0)
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], Isf, vds=mpd.vgs)
    vpd = VDD - mpd.vgs
    mpl = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=max(VDD - vamp, 0.2))
    msf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_sf"], p["Lsf"], Isf, vds=max(vpd - vout, 0.15), vsb=vout)
    # ---- NMOS mirror of IREF -> follower sink ----
    mr = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mr = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, iref, vds=mr.vgs)
    ms = lut.size("n", 12, 1.0, Isf, vds=max(vout, 0.2))

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "amp", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("Mpl", "amp", "pd", "vdd", "vdd", mpl)
    n.dev("Mpd", "pd", "pd", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    n.dev("Msf", "pd", "amp", "vout", "vss", msf)
    n.dev("Mr", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("Ms", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", ms)
    n.R("Rf", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("Cf", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- analytic small-signal model (3 poles) ----
    Ga = m1.gds + mpl.gds
    Ca = m1.cdd + mpl.cdd + msf.cgd + 0.3 * msf.cgg + m1.cgd
    Go = msf.gm + msf.gmbs + msf.gds + ms.gds + 1.0 / Rf
    Co = cl + ms.cdd + 0.3 * msf.cgg
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg
    Cfe = Cf + m1.cgd
    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        A = -(m1.gm / (Ga + s * Ca)) * (msf.gm / (Go + s * Co))
        Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cfe
        return A / (s * Cin + Yf * (1 - A))
    z0 = abs(zt(1e3))
    fs = np.logspace(4, 10, 3000)
    f3 = fs[-1]
    for f in fs:
        if abs(zt(f)) < z0 / math.sqrt(2):
            f3 = f; break

    kT4 = 4 * 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    en2 = kT4 * 0.8 / m1.gm * 2.0          # thermal + flicker allowance
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    in2 = kT4 / Rf + en2 * (w * (Cin + Cfe)) ** 2 + kT4 * 0.8 * mpl.gm / m1.gm ** 2 * (w * Cin) ** 2
    power = VDD * (iref + I1 + Isf)

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(z0), "f3db": f3, "in_noise_1m": math.sqrt(in2),
               "power": power, "vout_dc": vout}
